(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A computing system for authoring a document, comprising: a user input module configured to (1) receive first user input identifying content to be included in the document, the identified content being in a first form, and (2) receive second user input specifying a transformation operation to be performed on the identified content in order to transform the identified content from the first form into a second form; and a materialization module configured to apply the specified transformation operation to transform the identified content from the first form into the second form for display.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The computing system of claim 1 wherein the first user input received by the user input module identifies a data structure external to the document from which the identified content is available for retrieval.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The computing system of claim 1 wherein the first user input received by the user input module literally conveys the identified content.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The computing system of claim 1 wherein the user input module is configured to receive second user input specifying a plurality of transformation operations to be performed on the identified content.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The computing system of claim 4 wherein the user input module is configured to receive third user input specifying an order among the plurality of transformation operations in which the plurality of transformation operations is to be performed.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The computing system of claim 4, further comprising a precedence inference module configured to infer an order among the plurality of transformation operations in which the plurality of transformation operations is to be performed.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The computing system of claim 1 wherein the user input module is configured to receive the second user input relative to a displayed literal representation of the content identified by the first user input received by the user input module.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The computing system of claim 1 wherein the user input module is configured to receive the second user input relative to a displayed structural representation of the content identified by the first user input received by the user input module.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The computing system of claim 1 wherein the user input module is further configured to receive third user input specifying at least one edit to the identified content in the second form, the computer system further comprising: a revision module configured to edit the identified content in the second form for display in accordance with the at least one edit specified by the third user input received by the user input module.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The computing system of claim 9, further comprising: a storage module causing the identified content as edited by the revision module to be stored in the first form.
